content: Self-love increases or diminishes the good qualities of our friends in proportion to the satisfaction we receive from them.
author: François de La Rochefoucauld
sourceWork: Memoirs of the Regency of Anne of Austria
story:
This insight touches directly on the messy reality of human nature. Genuine love is not a transaction where you keep score of who gave what; it is a state of being where you extend warmth and goodwill without needing to control the other person.

François de La Rochefoucauld understood that real peace is never won by escaping the world or blaming external circumstances. The biggest barrier to deep connection is never external; it is our own fear of rejection. We build armor around our hearts to avoid pain, but that same armor ends up locking out the warmth and intimacy we crave.
reflectionPrompt: What hidden motive, insecurity, or fear might be silently driving your recent reactions?
